entities.name: Grimbly Wothis
entities.description: A minotaur dock overseer and House Dimir covert operative, Merret's boss and husband of Jitka.

entities.name: Merret
entities.description: A dock worker under Grimbly who is desperate to improve his family's fortunes.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: Dimir leader who reveals himself and alters memories.

entities.name: Aunt Bea
entities.description: A secret Dimir agent installed in Merret's home.

entities.name: Tashi
entities.description: Merret's family member whose memory is altered.

entities.name: Kodolaag
entities.description: Planted a whiskey bottle on Jitka to sneak into Udzec.

entities.name: Udzec
entities.description: A massive prison facility where Grimbly is imprisoned.

events.summary: A botched job leads Grimbly to task Merret with clearing fog from the harbor for an investor; Merret partly clears it with a surge of magic.
events.quote: The minotaur boss, suspicious but distracted by other matters, tasked Merret with clearing fog from the harbor for an investor.

events.summary: Merret breaks into Grimbly's home and narrowly avoids Jitka by turning invisible.
events.quote: Merret inadvertently cast a spell of invisibility on himself, evading detection.

events.summary: Merret accidentally drops a crate toward Grimbly and his investor; Grimbly pushes the investor into the river.
events.quote: Wothis managed to save the investor by pushing him into the river

events.summary: Grimbly tracks Merret home, threatens his family and plans to kidnap his magical infant son; Merret stuns him with a nightmare spell before Grimbly overpowers him.
events.quote: briefly incapacitating Wothis with a nightmare spell

events.summary: Lazav reveals himself, sends Grimbly away with no memory, installs Aunt Bea and alters Merret and Tashi's memories.
events.quote: Suddenly, Lazav revealed himself from the corner where he had been sitting all along.

events.summary: Grimbly is imprisoned in Udzec; Jitka visits him and is detained over a planted whiskey bottle while Kodolaag and Olrich pass through.
events.quote: Grimbly Wothis was later imprisoned in Udzec, a massive prison facility.

relations.quote: He's also the husband of Jitka Wothis .
Grimbly Wothis is a minotaur and Merret 's boss, a tough dock overseer.
a minotaur who serves in the covert operations of House Dimir
